title: Basic queen coverlet that screams beach house but too $$$; also cat approved
text:
Basic queen coverlet that screams beach house but too $$$; also cat approved. This is a queen-sized quilt but I ordered it to cover the top of my king-sized bed. It is made in China of 100% cotton with 100% polyester filling per the label. It can be machined washed on cold and tumble dried on low but I did not wash mine yet. There is a warning not to dry clean this.

As can be seen from the attached photos, it generously covers the top of my king-sized bed even though it is a queen size. It comes with two standard pillow shams.

The quality is okay. To me the material feels more like linen and a bit scratchy or cheap feeling. It is thin and definitely for summer. It feels like there is one layer of thin cotton batting stitched into the cloth. I do not feel it will last through many washings. I would have rated this four stars for this reason but I lowered my rating to three stars due to the exorbitant price of $107.27. I personally would not pay more than $45 for this because, even though it is nice, the quality is not great, in my opinion. It reminds me of a discount store find and those "bed-in-a-bag-type" products.

UPDATE August 16, 2019 - I washed the comforter and it washed and dried well but did come out slightly wrinkled.
